```sql
PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    title TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
    body TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tags (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
        CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 30)
        CHECK (name NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]*')
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS note_tags (
    note_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    tag_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (note_id, tag_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (note_id) REFERENCES notes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (tag_id) REFERENCES tags(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_note_tags_tag_id ON note_tags(tag_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notes_created_at ON notes(created_at DESC);
```

=== FILE: app.py ===
```python
import os
import re
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Optional

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Query, Response
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


DB_PATH = os.getenv("NOTES_DB", "notes.db")
SCHEMA_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "schema.sql"
TAG_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9]{1,30}$")

app = FastAPI()


class NoteCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str
    body: str = ""
    tags: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class NoteOut(BaseModel):
    id: int
    title: str
    body: str
    created_at: str
    tags: List[str]


def get_conn() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    return conn


def validate_title(title: str) -> None:
    if not (1 <= len(title) <= 120):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="title must be 1 to 120 characters")


def validate_tag(tag: str) -> None:
    if not TAG_RE.fullmatch(tag):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="tag must be lowercase letters/digits, 1 to 30 chars")


def validate_tags(tags: List[str]) -> None:
    for tag in tags:
        validate_tag(tag)


def dedupe_preserve_order(items: List[str]) -> List[str]:
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for item in items:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            out.append(item)
    return out


def utc_iso_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def fetch_note(conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int) -> Optional[dict]:
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, body, created_at FROM notes WHERE id = ?",
        (note_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None

    tags = [
        r["name"]
        for r in conn.execute(
            """
            SELECT t.name
            FROM tags t
            JOIN note_tags nt ON nt.tag_id = t.id
            WHERE nt.note_id = ?
            ORDER BY t.name ASC
            """,
            (note_id,),
        ).fetchall()
    ]

    return {
        "id": row["id"],
        "title": row["title"],
        "body": row["body"],
        "created_at": row["created_at"],
        "tags": tags,
    }


@app.on_event("startup")
def startup() -> None:
    schema_sql = SCHEMA_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    conn = get_conn()
    try:
        conn.executescript(schema_sql)
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()


@app.post("/notes", response_model=NoteOut, status_code=201)
def create_note(payload: NoteCreate) -> dict:
    validate_title(payload.title)
    validate_tags(payload.tags)
    tags = dedupe_preserve_order(payload.tags)

    conn = get_conn()
    try:
        created_at = utc_iso_now()
        cur = conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO notes(title, body, created_at) VALUES(?, ?, ?)",
            (payload.title, payload.body, created_at),
        )
        note_id = cur.lastrowid

        for tag in tags:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO tags(name) VALUES(?) ON CONFLICT(name) DO NOTHING",
                (tag,),
            )
            tag_row = conn.execute("SELECT id FROM tags WHERE name = ?", (tag,)).fetchone()
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO note_tags(note_id, tag_id) VALUES(?, ?)",
                (note_id, tag_row["id"]),
            )

        conn.commit()
        note = fetch_note(conn, note_id)
        return note
    finally:
        conn.close()


@app.get("/notes/{note_id}", response_model=NoteOut)
def get_note(note_id: int) -> dict:
    conn = get_conn()
    try:
        note = fetch_note(conn, note_id)
        if note is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="note not found")
        return note
    finally:
        conn.close()


@app.get("/notes", response_model=List[NoteOut])
def list_notes(tag: Optional[str] = Query(default=None)) -> List[dict]:
    if tag is not None:
        validate_tag(tag)

    conn = get_conn()
    try:
        if tag is None:
            rows = conn.execute(
                "SELECT id FROM notes ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC"
            ).fetchall()
        else:
            rows = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT DISTINCT n.id
                FROM notes n
                JOIN note_tags nt ON nt.note_id = n.id
                JOIN tags t ON t.id = nt.tag_id
                WHERE t.name = ?
                ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC
                """,
                (tag,),
            ).fetchall()

        return [fetch_note(conn, row["id"]) for row in rows]
    finally:
        conn.close()


@app.delete("/notes/{note_id}", status_code=204)
def delete_note(note_id: int) -> Response:
    conn = get_conn()
    try:
        cur = conn.execute("DELETE FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,))
        if cur.rowcount == 0:
            conn.rollback()
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="note not found")
        conn.commit()
        return Response(status_code=204)
    finally:
        conn.close()
```

```python
import importlib
import sys

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient


@pytest.fixture
def client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    db_path = tmp_path / "notes.db"
    monkeypatch.setenv("NOTES_DB", str(db_path))

    if "app" in sys.modules:
        del sys.modules["app"]

    app_module = importlib.import_module("app")

    with TestClient(app_module.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def test_create_and_get_note(client):
    res = client.post(
        "/notes",
        json={"title": "First note", "body": "hello", "tags": ["work", "todo"]},
    )
    assert res.status_code == 201
    created = res.json()

    assert isinstance(created["id"], int)
    assert created["title"] == "First note"
    assert created["body"] == "hello"
    assert created["created_at"].endswith("Z")
    assert set(created["tags"]) == {"work", "todo"}

    get_res = client.get(f"/notes/{created['id']}")
    assert get_res.status_code == 200
    fetched = get_res.json()
    assert fetched["id"] == created["id"]
    assert fetched["title"] == "First note"
    assert set(fetched["tags"]) == {"work", "todo"}


def test_list_notes_by_tag_newest_first(client):
    r1 = client.post("/notes", json={"title": "n1", "body": "", "tags": ["work"]})
    r2 = client.post("/notes", json={"title": "n2", "body": "", "tags": ["home"]})
    r3 = client.post("/notes", json={"title": "n3", "body": "", "tags": ["work", "home"]})

    assert r1.status_code == 201
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    assert r3.status_code == 201

    work_list = client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "work"})
    assert work_list.status_code == 200
    data = work_list.json()
    assert [n["id"] for n in data] == [r3.json()["id"], r1.json()["id"]]

    all_list = client.get("/notes")
    assert all_list.status_code == 200
    all_data = all_list.json()
    assert [n["id"] for n in all_data] == [r3.json()["id"], r2.json()["id"], r1.json()["id"]]


def test_delete_and_404(client):
    create = client.post("/notes", json={"title": "to-delete", "body": "", "tags": ["work"]})
    note_id = create.json()["id"]

    delete_res = client.delete(f"/notes/{note_id}")
    assert delete_res.status_code == 204
    assert delete_res.text == ""

    get_res = client.get(f"/notes/{note_id}")
    assert get_res.status_code == 404

    delete_again = client.delete(f"/notes/{note_id}")
    assert delete_again.status_code == 404


def test_validation_422(client):
    empty_title = client.post("/notes", json={"title": "", "body": "", "tags": []})
    assert empty_title.status_code == 422

    long_title = client.post("/notes", json={"title": "x" * 121, "body": "", "tags": []})
    assert long_title.status_code == 422

    bad_tag = client.post("/notes", json={"title": "ok", "body": "", "tags": ["Bad!"]})
    assert bad_tag.status_code == 422

    bad_query_tag = client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "Bad!"})
    assert bad_query_tag.status_code == 422


def test_get_missing_note_404(client):
    res = client.get("/notes/999999")
    assert res.status_code == 404
```

- `app.py` implements a complete FastAPI app using only `sqlite3`, creates tables on startup, validates inputs (title length, tag format), handles many-to-many tags without duplicates, returns ISO 8601 UTC timestamps, and implements all four endpoints with correct status codes.
- `openapi.yaml` provides a valid OpenAPI 3.0.3 description covering all endpoints, request/response schemas, and validation patterns.
- `test_app.py` contains comprehensive pytest tests using a temporary database, covering happy paths, tag filtering (newest-first), deletion, 404s, and all 422 validation cases.

The service is ready to run with `uvicorn app:app` after setting the `NOTES_DB` environment variable if desired.
